per_key_checks.assessment: Fallback filename and short caption for an image data URI with no usable encoded name. Exactly parallel to the existing pasted_file 'Tệp đã dán' and pasted_type 'Đã dán {mimeType}'; no extension, no MIME prose, no placeholder, as the sidecar requires. 'Ảnh' is the catalogue's compact-attachment word (ui.canvas.files.attachmentImage 'Ảnh đính kèm', ui.agents.avatar 'Ảnh đại diện'), while 'Hình ảnh' is used for the category label (ui.canvas.files.images), so the short form is the right register and the longer one would break the pasted_file parallel. Meaning and polarity preserved.

per_key_checks.call_site: getFileName() data:image/ branch; FileAttachment caption title (file-attachment.tsx).

per_key_checks.assessment: Names the seek slider's playback position for that clip, not a play/pause action, as the sidecar requires. 'Vị trí phát' is the catalogue's established term (ui.chat.attachments.playback_position 'Vị trí phát'), so no new vocabulary is coined. Word order {label}-last is explicitly permitted by the sidecar ('Word order may change around {label}'); 'của' is required here because 'vị trí phát' is a noun phrase, and it does not inflect or agree with the inserted label, so arbitrary filenames, Latin or CJK names and names with quotes/punctuation all stay grammatical. Two simultaneous clips stay distinguished because the label is retained.
per_key_checks.typography: NFC; no invisible/bidi characters; single plain {label}; no maxCells hint.
per_key_checks.call_site: sound-player.tsx sliderLabel -> aria-label of the seek slider; label is a required string prop.

per_key_checks.assessment: Byte-identical to the existing ui.chat.canonical.link_toolkit.actions_for 'Thao tác với {name}', i.e. the same English shape already rendered this way in this locale; also parallel to file_actions 'Thao tác với tệp' and image_actions.actions 'Thao tác với ảnh', which are the two unnamed fallbacks beside it. 'với' takes the bare name with no classifier, case, gender or number agreement, so any user filename — Latin, CJK, quoted, punctuated — reads correctly; {name} is inserted verbatim with no added extension, matching the sidecar. Not a command ('Thao tác' is the long-standing action noun used by both menus).
